writing.explanation:
Examples, generated properties, fuzz targets and integration tests provide different evidence. None guarantees which bug is found first or that untested invariants hold. State what each test checks, then preserve minimized failures as regressions.

Different tests answer different questions. A unit test can pin one known rule with a small input. A property test generates many inputs and checks an invariant, such as parse-then-format preserving a value. A fuzz target feeds malformed or unexpected inputs to a parser and watches for crashes or violated assertions. An integration test checks boundaries among modules or a real storage adapter. `None` of these is a substitute for knowing what behavior matters to users.

Start with a parser. Unit tests cover empty input, a normal record, and a known malformed delimiter. A property test can assert that valid generated records round-trip through serialization and parsing. Fuzzing can explore arbitrary bytes that a hand-written list never anticipated. An integration test can verify that a parsed record is stored and later retrieved through the public API. Keep a regression test for every serious bug found by fuzzing so it stays covered.

In an interview, prioritize by risk and cost. Pure functions are cheap to test often; network-dependent end-to-end tests may be slower and more fragile. Coverage percentage reports which lines ran, not whether the assertions were meaningful. Describe one failure mode each layer is meant to catch, how tests run in development, and what remains for manual or production observation. A good strategy is a set of evidence sources, not a pile of test labels.

When a property test fails, save the minimized counterexample as a named regression test. When a fuzz target finds malformed input that panics, classify whether the panic violates the API contract. Add a resource limit for deeply nested or huge inputs as well; not every parser failure is a type or memory safety bug.

Interview follow-up: Why can encode/decode roundtrip still pass if both share the same bug? Add an independent oracle or known external vectors.
